title: Search: filter by vehicle segment
description: The new category tiles (small car, compact, SUV, EV) link to the search by segment. Adds `segment` to the search; it is normalised in filters(), so it is part of the cache key. Test added.

defects.explanation: Accepts any string as segment instead of Rule::enum(Segment::class), so an unknown value such as segment=van returns an empty 200 instead of a 422.
